review.summary: One hand grasps the red mug from the back of the table (0.9s), carries it (1.8-2.7s) and sets it upright on the blue plate (3.6s), ending as in the robot's last frame with the distractors unmoved.
issues: Slight camera drift between frames 0.0s and 1.4s; acceptable
review.verify: Checked all 31 fps=6 frames (more/f_001-031), plus a full-size look at f_009-012 and f_022-025. Frame 0 matches the robot's first frame with the robot removed: red mug, yellow mug, blue plate, white plate, candy bar and bowl in the same layout. One hand grasps the red mug at the back, carries it and sets it upright on the blue plate (f_020-022). The yellow mug, bowl, white plate and candy bar keep their positions; they are only occluded at times by the arm (f_011), and the hand passes near the candy bar while leaving (f_023) without moving it. No copy appears, no second hand, no overlays. Last frame: mug upright on the blue plate, the same end state as the robot at 14.2s.
